name: Humidifier Maintenance
summary:
Humidifier Maintenance is an immersive VR training application developed to support hands-on learning in equipment maintenance. As part of the Immerse Learn Humidifier Maintenance micro-credential program, this application allows learners to build practical skills through realistic, interactive simulations.
